description: Rearrange PDF pages into any order — move pages up and down in a visual list, then download the reordered document.

faqs.a: Select a page in the list and use the ↑ / ↓ buttons, or jump it straight to the top or bottom.
faqs.q: How do I move a page?

faqs.a: Yes — the list shows every page in its current order with a live preview of the sequence.
faqs.q: Can I see the current order?

faqs.a: The reordered PDF contains the same page content, just in your new order.
faqs.q: Does reordering change the page content?

faqs.a: No — everything is processed locally in your browser.

howto: Use ↑ ↓ (or Top / Bottom) to arrange pages in the list.
Check the new sequence at the top of the list.
title: PDF Page Reorder
